messages.author: 4bd1e087b45f3e85
messages.subject: plotting fold change per chromosome in asci order
parts:
to whom it may concern.

I wish to plot expression levels of genes for each chromosome and get the chromomes in asci order.  My list:
ID  Chromosome Fold Change
xy   3                  1.5
zu   X                  1.8

expect
the vectors
id for ID
ch for Chromosome
fc for Fold Chane

I tried:
qplot (ch, fc, data=daten)

Principally the plot is okay but ...
I get the chromomes on the x-axis in asci order (1, 10 etc). Of course I prefer the "classical" order (1,2,...X,Y). How does this work?
Thanks
hermann Norpois

messages.author: 373beb702917b8b5
messages.subject: Re: plotting fold change per chromosome in asci order
parts:
Hi Hermann,

You can use the mixedsort() function in the gtools package, like this:

library(gtools)
daten$ch <- factor(daten$ch, levels = mixedsort(daten$ch))
qplot (ch, fc, data=daten)

Best,
Ista
